help.sum:
Shipping Information
What are your postage fees?
All orders are dispatched from our UK warehouse using a fully tracked Royal Mail or DPD service.
UK orders over £90 qualify for free Royal Mail Tracked 48 delivery. For orders under £90, you can choose from a range of delivery options at checkout.
We also ship internationally to Ireland, the EU, USA, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. Any applicable duties and taxes will be displayed at checkout, so there are no surprises when your order arrives.
How long will it take to receive my order?
Most orders are dispatched the same day or next working day. During busy periods, such as new launches, restocks, or Black Friday, please allow up to 3 working days.
For next day delivery with DPD, your order needs to be placed before 12pm.
Delivery times will vary depending on your location and the shipping service chosen at checkout. You'll receive a tracking email once your order has been dispatched so you can follow its journey.

Returns & Refunds
To start the return process for your order, please follow the link below to our Royal Mail returns portal start my return
Frequently Asked Questions
Do you accept returns?
Yes we do! We offer a free returns service for UK based customers
You can return any of your items within 14 days of receipt of your order
Items must be in unworn and unwashed condition with tags still attached to be considered for a full refund
We do not accept returns for products which have make-up, deodorant, or self-tan on them, nor products that smell like smoke, perfume, body sprays or creams
Please note that we are unable to offer a full refund if the above conditions are not met
If you are based outside the UK and wish to return an item, please email us so that we can start your return
Are there any charges for return?
We charge a £3.50 fee for returns, which covers the cost of processing your return. It's deducted from your refund, and you can request your return through our Returns Portal and use the provided Royal Mail label or QR code.

Frequently Asked Questions
What size should I buy?
For the best fit, please refer to our sizing chart.
How should I wash my Avo clothing?
We recommend washing your items at 30 degrees or below. Hang dry and do not tumble dry. To optimise the lifespan of your garment we suggest a cold machine wash or hand wash followed by hanging to air dry. Do not bleach, dry clean or iron.

about.sum:
The Story of Avo Activewear
Avo is the UK’s 1st sportswear brand dedicated exclusively to women 5'3" and under. Our mission is simple: to create high-quality activewear that fits petite proportions properly – no rolling up hems, no awkwardly high waistbands, and no compromising on style or function.
What began as a personal frustration has grown into an award-winning brand recognised by Women’s Health, Heat, and Woman & Home. We've been named a Drapers Disruptor Finalist and received the Bristol Life Award for Best Small Business, celebrating our commitment to innovation in a space that had long overlooked petite women.
Our collection includes best-selling flared leggings, sports bras, maternity styles, and everyday activewear essentials – all crafted with purpose, precision, and petite women in mind.
Meet The Founder - Ally Patterson
Standing at 5'1", I've experienced the challenges petite women face when shopping for activewear. Frustrated with the lack of options that truly fit, I decided to take matters into my own hands. My journey began in 2017, armed with nothing but basic sewing skills and a determination to make a change.

Refund policy
Refund Policy
We offer an easy, tracked returns service for UK customers, and you can return any of your items within 14 days of receiving your order.
To be eligible for a full refund, items must be unworn and unwashed, with tags still attached. We can't accept returns for items with make-up, deodorant or self-tan on them, or items that smell of smoke, perfume, body sprays or creams. If these conditions aren't met, we're unable to offer a full refund.
How to return
UK customers can start a return through our Royal Mail returns portal here: https://www.royalmail.com/track-my-return#/details/9074. Once your return is requested, you'll be given a Royal Mail label or QR code to use.
If you're based outside the UK, please email hello@avoactivewear.com and we'll help you start your return.
Please always use the returns portal so we can process your return properly. If you send an order back without requesting it through the portal or using the label provided, the return fee still applies, any postage you've paid yourself can't be reimbursed, and you'll need to include your order details inside the parcel.
